evaluationContext.purpose: Calibrate the report schema without rating the whole repository.
evaluationContext.claimScope: Only the report shape and anti-gaming invariants.

evidence.scope: Checked-in contract structure and acceptance mapping only.
limitations: No live Agent, host, cross-domain, or longitudinal behavior is evaluated.
The fixture proves schema mechanics, not lifecycle value.

unknowns: No Agent process is present in this calibration.
limitations: A zero-model fixture cannot establish AI process behavior.

floorResults.disposition: The bounded schema claim is source-linked.
The fixture claims only schema calibration.

unknownsAndLimitations: The fixture does not evaluate the repository, a product, or a live Agent.

nextEvidence: Apply the schema to one bounded repository target without claiming project-wide quality.
nextEvidenceAndFallback.fallback: Retain the contract and report schema as research-only if a valid bounded target is not available.

revalidationAndRetirementTriggers: Revalidate when dimensions, evidence grades, floor candidates, or acceptance authority change.

acceptanceAuthority.scope: No acceptance or hard-standard authority is requested.

claimBoundary: The report schema and deterministic cross-field rules are calibrated; software-engineering quality and lifecycle value remain unassessed.
